tasks.title: Configure dependencies and test markers
tasks.description: Add `fastembed` and `numpy` (pinned ranges) to `pyproject.toml`, register pytest markers `model` and `sim`, regenerate `uv.lock`.
tasks.details:
Where: `pyproject.toml`
Requirement: OPS-01
Reuses: `../mcp-manager/pyproject.toml` dependency style
Done when:
- [ ] `uv sync --locked` succeeds with the new `uv.lock` committed
- [ ] `uv run pytest --markers` lists `model` and `sim`
- [ ] Gate check passes: `uv sync --locked && uv run python -m compileall -q src && uv run pytest -q -m "not model and not sim"`
Gate: build
Commit: `build(deps): add fastembed, numpy and pytest markers`
Spec: .specs/features/vrep-mcp/spec.md

tasks.title: Catalog loading with fallbacks and hash
tasks.description: `VrepError`, `Entry` normalization (`entries`, `get`, `list_namespaces`, `catalog_hash`) with Lua fallback for missing `python_raw`, aligned-only `param_docs`, and the OPS-04 error.
tasks.details:
Where: `src/vrep_mcp/catalog.py`
Requirement: CAT-01, CAT-07 (entry part), CAT-09, CALL-08, OPS-04
Reuses: draft `entries`, `list_namespaces`
Done when:
- [ ] `list_namespaces()` returns the counts in CAT-01 exactly
- [ ] `get("sim.serialRead")` carries `lua` params and `lua_raw` signature
- [ ] Unknown name raises `VrepError` with the CAT-09 message
- [ ] A missing or corrupt catalog file (via `VREP_DATA_DIR` tmp dir) raises the OPS-04 message
- [ ] `catalog_hash()` changes when one file's bytes change
- [ ] Gate check passes: `uv run pytest -q -m "not model and not sim"`
- [ ] Test count: ≥ 6 tests in `tests/test_catalog.py` pass
Gate: quick
Commit: `feat(catalog): load processed catalog with lua and doc fallbacks`
Spec: .specs/features/vrep-mcp/spec.md

tasks.title: Schema builder
tasks.description: `schema(name)` returning the CAT-02 shape for functions and the CAT-08 shape for constants, with type mapping, `x-vrep-type`, required set, and aligned descriptions.
tasks.details:
Where: `src/vrep_mcp/catalog.py` (modify)
Requirement: CAT-02, CAT-03, CAT-04, CAT-05, CAT-06, CAT-07, CAT-08
Reuses: draft `schema`, `_is_optional`
Done when:
- [ ] `sim.setJointTargetPosition` required = `["objectHandle","targetPosition"]`, `targetPosition.type == "number"`
- [ ] A `buffer`/`any`-typed param has no `type` key and keeps `x-vrep-type`
- [ ] A function with misaligned definitions has no property `description`; an aligned one has them
- [ ] `sim.serialRead` required excludes `closingString` and `timeout` (Lua fallback)
- [ ] `sim.handle_world` returns `{kind:"constant", namespace:"sim", type:"int"}`
- [ ] Gate check passes: `uv run pytest -q -m "not model and not sim"`
- [ ] Test count: ≥ 11 tests in `tests/test_catalog.py` pass
Gate: quick
Commit: `feat(catalog): build JSON input schemas from catalog entries`
Spec: .specs/features/vrep-mcp/spec.md

tasks.title: Argument validation and positional mapping
tasks.description: `to_positional(name, arguments)` enforcing CALL-04..07 and mapping named args to the positional list truncated after the last given argument.
tasks.details:
Where: `src/vrep_mcp/catalog.py` (modify)
Requirement: CALL-01 (mapping), CALL-04, CALL-05, CALL-06, CALL-07
Reuses: draft `build_args`; type check idea from `../mcp-manager/src/tools/call_tool.py`
Done when:
- [ ] Each of the 4 error messages matches the spec text exactly
- [ ] `int` accepted for `number`; `bool` rejected for `integer` and `number`; untyped params accept any JSON
- [ ] `{"objectHandle":5,"targetPosition":1.5}` → `[5, 1.5]`; empty arguments for a no-param function → `[]`
- [ ] Gate check passes: `uv run pytest -q -m "not model and not sim"`
- [ ] Test count: ≥ 17 tests in `tests/test_catalog.py` pass
Gate: quick
Commit: `feat(catalog): validate and map named arguments to positional`
Spec: .specs/features/vrep-mcp/spec.md

tasks.title: Embedding search with hash-keyed cache
tasks.description: `index.search` with input validation, namespace/kind filters, cosine score ×100, and lazy `.npy` cache at `VREP_CACHE_DIR/index-<hash16>.npy`.
tasks.details:
Where: `src/vrep_mcp/index.py`
Requirement: SRCH-01, SRCH-02, SRCH-03, SRCH-06, SRCH-07, SRCH-08, SRCH-09, SRCH-10, SRCH-11, OPS-03 (model lazy)
Reuses: mcp-manager model id + `"<name>: <description>"` text format
Done when:
- [ ] With a fake embedder: results sorted desc, ≤ `max_results`, fields per SRCH-01, description ≤ 200 chars
- [ ] Filters return only the matching namespace / kind
- [ ] First search writes the cache file; a second search with a fresh module state loads it and calls the embedder only for the query
- [ ] SRCH-08..11 messages match exactly
- [ ] Importing `vrep_mcp.index` does not instantiate the embedder
- [ ] Gate check passes: `uv run pytest -q -m "not model and not sim"`
- [ ] Test count: ≥ 9 tests in `tests/test_index.py` pass
Gate: quick
Commit: `feat(index): add embedding search with on-disk cache`
Spec: .specs/features/vrep-mcp/spec.md

tasks.title: ZMQ bridge with timeout, reset, and lock
tasks.description: `bridge.call` holding a module lock, lazy `RemoteAPIClient(host, port, verbose=0)` with `RCVTIMEO`/`LINGER`, reset on timeout, error wrapping, and `jsonable`.
tasks.details:
Where: `src/vrep_mcp/bridge.py`
Requirement: CALL-01, CALL-02, CALL-03, CALL-08, CALL-09, CALL-10, CALL-11, CALL-12, OPS-03 (lazy connect)
Reuses: draft `_api`, `call`, `jsonable` from `catalog.py` (moved out)
Done when:
- [ ] Fake API: positional invocation, tuple→list, bytes→base64, `None`→`null`, constant read ignores `arguments`
- [ ] Fake client raising `zmq.Again` → CALL-09 message; next call builds a new client (CALL-10)
- [ ] Fake API raising `Exception("boom")` → `CoppeliaSim error in <name>: boom`; missing attribute → the "not available" message
- [ ] Two threads calling concurrently never overlap inside the API (CALL-12)
- [ ] Invalid arguments raise before the client factory is called
- [ ] Draft ZMQ code removed from `catalog.py`
- [ ] Gate check passes: `uv run pytest -q -m "not model and not sim"`
- [ ] Test count: ≥ 9 tests in `tests/test_bridge.py` pass
Gate: quick
Commit: `feat(bridge): add ZMQ bridge with timeout, reconnect and lock`
Spec: .specs/features/vrep-mcp/spec.md
